title: Jazzy Venezuelan Fried Rice
description: Delicious Venezuelan-style fried rice with a twist of jazzy flavors. Perfect for a quick and flavorful lunch.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add diced onion and sauté until translucent, about 2-3 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add 1 cup of Venezuelan rice and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Add 1 cup of fried rice, diced tomatoes, and frozen peas.
Stir-fry for another 5 minutes, until everything is well combined and heated through.
Add 2 cups of jazzy rice to the skillet and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Optional: Add your favorite jazz-inspired spices for an extra kick.
